framing_annotations_accepted_offsets_ck.name: framing_annotations_accepted_offsets_ck
framing_annotations_accepted_offsets_ck.value: "framing_annotations"."decision" <> 'accepted' or ("framing_annotations"."start_offset" is not null and "framing_annotations"."end_offset" is not null and "framing_annotations"."start_offset" >= 0 and "framing_annotations"."end_offset" > "framing_annotations"."start_offset")

framing_gap_classifications_subject_ck.name: framing_gap_classifications_subject_ck
framing_gap_classifications_subject_ck.value: ("framing_gap_classifications"."classification" = 'missing' and "framing_gap_classifications"."association_id" is null and nullif(btrim("framing_gap_classifications"."missing_target"), '') is not null) or ("framing_gap_classifications"."classification" <> 'missing' and nullif(btrim("framing_gap_classifications"."association_id"), '') is not null and "framing_gap_classifications"."missing_target" is null)

matrix_versions_kind_study_ck.name: matrix_versions_kind_study_ck
matrix_versions_kind_study_ck.value: ("matrix_versions"."kind" = 'audit' and "matrix_versions"."resonance_study_id" is null) or ("matrix_versions"."kind" = 'resonance' and "matrix_versions"."resonance_study_id" is not null)

prompt_cells_audit_resonance_shape_ck.name: prompt_cells_audit_resonance_shape_ck
prompt_cells_audit_resonance_shape_ck.value: ("prompt_cells"."intent"::text = 'simulation' and "prompt_cells"."persona_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."market_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."stimulus_id" is not null and "prompt_cells"."panel_persona_key" is not null) or ("prompt_cells"."intent"::text = 'representation' and "prompt_cells"."persona_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."market_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."stimulus_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."panel_persona_key" is null) or ("prompt_cells"."intent"::text not in ('simulation', 'representation') and "prompt_cells"."stimulus_id" is null and "prompt_cells"."panel_persona_key" is null)
